fragments.cedar: permit ( principal is User, action == Action::"gdpr.dsar_submit", resource is DataSubject ) when { principal == resource.subject_principal && context.cell.certification_levels.contains("eu-sovereign") && context.tenant.compliance_pack_active("pack-eu-gdpr-2018-baseline") && context.authentication_method == "webauthn" };

permit ( principal == DsarOrchestrator::"workflow-engine", action == Action::"intelligence.erase_cohort_membership", resource is DataSubject ) when { context.cell.certification_levels.contains("eu-sovereign") && context.dsar.rights_invoked.contains("art17") };

permit ( principal is User, action == Action::"gdpr.article_22_appeal", resource is AutomatedDecision ) when { principal == resource.subject_principal && context.cell.certification_levels.contains("eu-sovereign") && resource.decision_class in ["throttle","ranking","credit-limit","eligibility","content-moderation"] };

permit ( principal in Regulator::"berliner-beauftragte-data-protection", action == Action::"regulator.read_aggregate", resource is AuditChain ) when { principal.attested_authority == "DE-Berlin-DPA" && context.purpose_of_access in ["Art-58-investigation","Art-30-evidence"] };
